properties.name: min_size
properties.comment: The least extent the target keeps (Windows Forms' MinSize, default 25). A negative or non-finite value throws std::invalid_argument and changes nothing; the next drag or split position uses it.
prepare: require_extent(incoming, "Splitter min_size must be finite and not negative");

properties.name: min_extra
properties.comment: The least extent left for the rest of the dock area (Windows Forms' MinExtra, default 25). Refused as min_size is.
prepare: require_extent(incoming, "Splitter min_extra must be finite and not negative");

not_properties.name: split_position
not_properties.reason: the target's extent, computed from the current target; set_split_position resizes the target

not_properties.name: target
not_properties.reason: read-only, found from the dock layout
